title: Notification regarding Vacation Court sitting to take up urgent matters during the ensuring Summer Vacation starting from 29th June to 10th July, 2026.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Dated the 20th June, 2026
No. HCM/1/96/BENCH/ : The Hon'ble Chief Justice is pleased to constitute
Vacation Bench sitting with the following Hon’ble Judges to take up urgent matters during the
ensuing Summer Vacation starting from 29th June, 2026 to 10th July, 2026 as shown below:-
VACATION COURT
Date
lst July, 2026
8th July, 2026
Hon'ble Judge for Vacation Bench
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma
Further, it is informed that urgent matter pertaining to Civil and Criminal which is sought
to be listed before the Vacation Bench may be allowed to be filed till 12:00 Noon of 30th June,
2026 (Tuesday) and 7th July, 2026 (Tuesday). They shall be accompanied by separate
applications for urgent listing before the Vacation Bench clearly mentioning the reasons for
urgency .
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. A]IT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
